Package Application

Class UserInterfaceTest

java.lang.Object
Application.UserInterfaceTest
public class UserInterfaceTest extends Object
JUnit test class for the UserInterface class.

This test class verifies that:

  • The UI Scene is created with the expected dimensions.
  • Updating the coin display reflects the pet's coin count.
  • Updating the score display reflects the pet's score (verified indirectly).
Due to the nature of JavaFX UI components, these tests are basic and primarily validate that the UI construction and update methods work without error. For more robust UI testing, consider using an integration testing framework like TestFX.

  • Method Details

    • initJfx

      public static void initJfx() throws Exception
      Initializes the JavaFX runtime before any tests run.

      This is necessary because the UserInterface class constructs JavaFX components, which require the JavaFX platform to be initialized before use.

      Throws:
      Exception - if the JavaFX platform fails to initialize

    • setUp

      public void setUp()
      Sets up test objects before each test. Creates a test Duck with preset values, a GameSettingsAndStats instance, and a dummy Label for the coin display.

    • testGetScene

      public void testGetScene()
      Tests that the UserInterface creates a non-null Scene with the expected dimensions.

    • testUpdateCoinDisplay

      public void testUpdateCoinDisplay()
      Tests that updating the coin display correctly reflects the pet's coin count.

    • testUpdateScore

      public void testUpdateScore()
      Tests that updating the score display reflects the pet's current score.

      Note: Since the score label is not directly exposed, this test verifies indirectly by checking that the scene's layout contains the expected score text.
